## Change and intended behavior

Describe the operation/profile and what should change for a concrete input. Identify affected policy components and any intended changes in permission.

## Evidence

- Baseline and candidate policy hashes:
- Evaluator revision and frozen suite hash:
- Model, settings and input-length strata:
- Evidence bundle(s), including errors and cases not run:
- Attack misses, benign false alarms and abstentions changed:
- Evidence provenance: contributor-reported / independently reproduced / trusted signed receipt (only when supported)

## Review notes

Call out changed expectations, coverage gaps, incompatible profiles and unresolved tradeoffs. Do not include API keys or private customer material. A passing finite suite is not proof of safety. Policy changes remain subject to review; paid model calls are not run automatically in CI.
